digest.component_or_area: MCP tool search / Serena symbol tools
propositions: Serena symbol tools are deferred by default, requiring an extra ToolSearch round-trip before use, creating friction asymmetry vs. other tools
ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH is the only available control for deferral and is all-or-nothing (no per-tool or per-server lever exists)
Loading all Serena tool schemas un-deferred costs a minimum of 25,454 tokens (serena-only baseline) to eliminate the discovery-step friction
A tracked .claude/settings.json with ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=false must be shipped with .gitignore negation to make symbol tools resident by default

The change is configuration-only with a one-line revert; the per-MCP-server cost (38k+ tokens for github/tokensave/headroom/serena combined) is higher than Serena alone but justified by preventing defects from earlier failure cycles
